subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Operational Resilience
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Operational Resilience.

hook.text: You can't prevent every disruption. The question is: how quickly can you recover and keep serving customers?

buildup.text: Operational resilience shifts focus from preventing all failures to ensuring recovery within acceptable timeframes.

discovery.text: The UK's operational resilience framework requires firms to set 'impact tolerances' for critical business services.

twist.text: Companies discover their recovery plans don't work only when they actually need them. Testing is essential.

climax.text: Resilience accepts that things will break. The goal is to bend without breaking and recover fast.

punchline.text: Things will break. Recover fast. That's resilience.

quiz.question: What does operational resilience focus on?
options: Recovering quickly from disruptions within acceptable timeframes
